newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton prices mixed, Punjab variety gains.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton prices mixed, Punjab variety gains.

text.p: Indian cotton prices on Tuesday were mixed with some Punjab varieties gaining and others easing. Gujarat varieties were steady, dealers said.
Among Punjab varieties, Bengal-deshi moved up on fresh mill buying while other varieties fell on profit-taking by stockists at higher levels, a dealer said.

In spot deals, Bengal-deshi rose 15 rupees to 925/965 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while Punjab F-414 moved down 15/20 rupees to 1,935/1,955 rupees per maund. Punjab saw-ginned fell 20 rupees to 1,650/1,680 rupees per maund.

Gujarat cotton consolidated recent gains and remained steady at a higher level in light trade, dealers said. Gujarat Kalyan (medium-staple) was steady at 13,900/14,500 rupees per candy (355.56 kg), wagad cotton at 12,800 rupees per candy and Kala-ginned cotton at 12,300/12,400 rupees per candy.
